metadata.title: Flow cytometry - cell-surface marker staining
metadata.purpose: Label cell-surface markers on a single-cell suspension with a fluorophore-conjugated antibody (after Fc blocking), wash, optionally fix, and acquire on a flow cytometer to quantify marker-positive populations.
metadata.scope: Extracellular (surface-only) staining of a single-cell suspension with a directly conjugated antibody; no permeabilization. Fc blocking, cold-and-dark staining, and optional paraformaldehyde fixation. Not covering intracellular/intranuclear staining, which requires fixation + permeabilization.
beforeYouBegin: Prepare a single-cell suspension and count cells; keep everything cold (on ice) and protected from light once fluorophores are added.
Choose directly conjugated antibodies whose fluorophores match the cytometer's lasers/detectors; titrate each antibody to its optimal amount per test.
Include a viability dye (e.g. 7-AAD or a fixable viability dye) and full compensation/gating controls (unstained, single-stain, FMO); these are recommended but reagent-specific.

materials.name: FACS / staining buffer
materials.specification: PBS with 0.5-1% BSA (or 5-10% FBS) and 0.1% NaN3; kept ice-cold.
materials.hazard: Contains sodium azide (NaN3) - toxic; do not mix with acids.
materials.rawText: ice cold FACS Buffer (PBS, 0.5-1% BSA or 5-10% FBS, 0.1% NaN3)

materials.name: Fc blocking reagent
materials.specification: Fc-receptor blocking reagent (e.g. anti-CD16/CD32 for mouse, or human FcR blocker). Exact reagent is species-specific.
materials.rawText: 100 ul of Fc block ... diluted in FACS buffer at 1:50 ratio

materials.name: Fluorophore-conjugated anti-surface-marker antibody
materials.specification: Directly conjugated primary antibody against the surface marker of interest. Target, clone, fluorophore, and RRID are assay-specific.

materials.name: Paraformaldehyde (1-4% in PBS)
materials.specification: Optional fixative for stained cells prior to acquisition.
materials.hazard: Toxic; suspected carcinogen; use in a fume hood.
materials.rawText: 100 ul 1-4% paraformaldehyde ... 10-15 min at room temperature

materials.name: PBS
materials.specification: Ice-cold PBS for final resuspension of fixed cells.
materials.rawText: 200 ul to 1 ml of ice cold PBS

equipment.name: Flow cytometer
equipment.settings: Lasers/detectors configured for the chosen fluorophores; set voltages with unstained and single-stain controls

equipment.name: Refrigerated centrifuge
equipment.settings: ~1500 rpm, 5 min, 4 C (convert rpm to x g for your rotor)

samples.name: Single-cell suspension
samples.organism: Mammalian cells (specific source not fixed by this protocol)
samples.description: 1-5 x 10^6 cells/mL in ice-cold FACS buffer; 100 uL (~1-5 x 10^5 cells) stained per tube.

samples.name: Surface-stained cells
samples.description: Cells after Fc block and antibody labeling, washed to remove unbound antibody.

samples.name: Fixed stained cells / acquisition sample
samples.description: Optionally fixed, resuspended cells ready for flow-cytometer acquisition and the resulting FCS data.

steps.action: Aliquot the single-cell suspension into FACS tubes in ice-cold FACS buffer.
Add Fc blocking reagent and incubate on ice.

parameters.rawText: diluted in FACS buffer at 1:50 ratio

steps.expectedResult: Fc receptors blocked to reduce non-specific antibody binding.

steps.action: Resuspend cells in fluorophore-conjugated antibody diluted in FACS buffer and incubate in the dark.

parameters.rawText: at room temperature or 4 C in the dark

steps.criticalNotes: Protect from light; on-ice staining may need longer incubation. Titrate antibody amount per test.

steps.action: Wash cells in FACS buffer (centrifuge and resuspend), repeating to remove unbound antibody.

parameters.rawText: washed in staining or assay buffer at least three times

steps.action: Optionally fix stained cells in paraformaldehyde.
steps.criticalNotes: Skip if acquiring immediately; some fluorophores/epitopes are fixation-sensitive.

steps.action: Resuspend cells in ice-cold PBS (or FACS buffer) for acquisition.

parameters.rawText: 200 ul to 1 ml of ice cold PBS

steps.action: Acquire samples on the flow cytometer as soon as possible.
steps.expectedResult: Marker-positive populations resolved from unstained/FMO controls.
steps.criticalNotes: Analyze promptly; set voltages and compensation with controls.

controls.name: Unstained control
controls.description: Cells with no antibody to set baseline autofluorescence and PMT voltages.

controls.name: Single-stain compensation controls
controls.description: One fluorophore per tube (cells or beads) to calculate spectral compensation.

controls.name: FMO (fluorescence-minus-one) controls
controls.description: All fluorophores except one, to set accurate positive/negative gates.

controls.name: Viability dye
controls.description: e.g. 7-AAD or a fixable viability dye to exclude dead cells; recommended but reagent-specific.

controls.name: Isotype control
controls.description: Matched isotype conjugate to assess non-specific binding.

expectedOutputs: FCS data files with marker-positive vs marker-negative populations.
Percent positive and median fluorescence intensity (MFI) for the surface marker after gating on live single cells.

troubleshooting.cause: No Fc block; antibody over-titrated; dead-cell binding
troubleshooting.solution: Add Fc block; titrate antibody; add a viability dye and gate out dead cells

troubleshooting.cause: Antibody too dilute; fluorophore mismatched to detector; marker downregulated
troubleshooting.solution: Increase antibody; confirm laser/filter match; verify marker expression
Acquire before fixing, or use a fixation-compatible fluorophore

safety: FACS buffer contains sodium azide (NaN3) - toxic; never mix with acids; dispose per institutional rules.
Paraformaldehyde is toxic and a suspected carcinogen - handle in a fume hood.
Primary cells/samples may be biohazardous - handle at the appropriate biosafety level.
limitations: Values are grounded in one institutional surface-staining protocol (src1); the specific antibody target/clone/fluorophore and its optimal titer, the Fc-block reagent, cell source, viability dye, and cytometer configuration are experiment-specific and marked needsReview. Centrifuge speed is given in rpm as in the source and must be converted to x g for the local rotor. Surface-only workflow; intracellular targets require added fixation + permeabilization (out of scope).
